provider.name: iNaturalist
provider.organization_type: global community-science observation, taxonomy, identification, geospatial, media, conservation, project, API, mobile, and biodiversity data platform
provider.description: iNaturalist is a global community-science platform for recording observations of organisms, sharing photos and sounds, obtaining community identifications, curating taxonomy and common names, managing projects and places, assessing data quality, protecting sensitive locations, exporting research-grade biodiversity data, and providing public APIs, mobile apps, and computer-vision suggestions.
institutional_context: Global community-science and biodiversity research community
GBIF, TDWG, taxonomic authorities, and conservation partners

purpose.summary: This file is a crawl-ready source catalog for collecting iNaturalist documentation, observation and identification models, taxonomy, projects, places, media, geoprivacy, quality grades, conservation, APIs, OAuth, exports, GBIF integration, computer vision, licenses, citations, source code, mobile applications, and organizational context.
purpose.authoritative_notice: iNaturalist, its network members, users, taxon curators, source taxonomies, data publishers, GBIF, TDWG standards, and cited repositories remain authoritative for records, taxonomy, media, licenses, API behavior, versions, and contact information.
